Name: Vegan in the Valley
Author: orochifrogu
Description:
UPDATE 1.1.2: fixes roasted carrots bug <3 xoxo

UPDATE 1.1.1: Added 6 NEW VEGAN RECIPES and some unhinged letters from 'Secret Vegan Admirer'!! Carrot muffin, Daddy's Recipe, Mommy's Cookies, V.L.T, Cinnamon Rolls, and Acai Bowl!!! 

UPDATE 1.0.1: fixed 'rice noodles' sprite! It was showing up in the cooking menu as 'vegan sushi'. also fixed a spelling error. ALSO, changed mail.json so that translations can be made easier, moving all information to be able to be translated within i18n default.json 

Ah, it's a wonderful life to be vegan! <3 However, I was wishing my cute little farmer could enjoy some of the things I like to cook in the game, too! So, I created this <3 

All recipes will be sent to you by a 'Secret Vegan Admirer', who is actually kind of weird, too. (see images above). 

ALL RECIPES ONLY REQUIRE VANILLA-GAME INGREDIENTS! <3
Oh, and most recipes have pretty good buffs, as being vegan is just wonderful for your health, so your farmer can now enjoy some pretty sweet perks as well. I also tried to balance the price of each recipe considering base level quality of produce. (most will allow you to profit!)

NOTE: compatible with Love of Cooking

THIS MOD ADDS 21 RECIPES! NO VANILLA GAME RECIPES ARE CHANGED, JUST 21 NEW ONES ADDED

The recipes will unlock and will be sent to you after reaching certain heart levels with the villagers! All are unlocked between 1-8 hearts. Here are the villagers that are affected: Gus 1 , Marnie 3, Shane 2, Maru 6, Wizard 4, Emily 5, Vincent 2, Abigail 4, Clint 7, Caroline 8, Jas 3, Sam 4, Pierre 6, Sebastian 7, Alex 7, Penny 3, Jodi 3, Willy 3, Lewis 3, Pam 4.
